TZA.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
The AI tool sits inside a health surveillance system, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: Tanzania's Ministry of Health has introduced an AI-based triage tool in its DHIS2 event-based surveillance system, which per DHIS2 cut average time to triage for most alerts from 36 hours to almost instantaneous.
facts.system: AI-based alert triage tool in DHIS2 event-based surveillance (EBS)

facts.fact: DHIS2 reports the Ministry of Health's AI triage tool reduced average time to triage for the majority of submitted alerts from 36 hours to almost instantaneous.
facts.system: AI-based alert triage tool in DHIS2 event-based surveillance (EBS)

systems.system: Event-based surveillance (EBS) with AI triage tool

facts.fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab implemented the AI-based alert triage tool now used by Tanzania's Ministry of Health in its event-based surveillance; the document says it uses a rule-based approach with human interaction, with machine learning planned.

TZA.note: Only surveillance systems are described; no routine HMIS or EMR statement.
